Country.evidence_source: Men meeting the inclusion criteria of (a) residing in Canada

Population.evidence_source: Men meeting the inclusion criteria of (a) residing in Canada, (b) being 19 years or older, and (c) having lost a male friend, partner, or family member to suicide

Type.evidence_source: A follow-up in-depth individual interview was scheduled where participants shared and narrated their photographs. Digitally recorded interviews lasting between 60 to 90 minutes were conducted from 2014 to 2016

Area.evidence_source: The participants were also explicitly asked to share their views on masculinity and male suicide, including their perspectives about the high male suicide rates, and why male suicide in Western countries is 3 times higher than female suicide rates. [...] A follow-up in-depth individual interview was scheduled where participants shared and narrated their photographs. [...] Structuring the interview questions around the photographs provided a sensitive way to privilege the participants' experiences and elicited their feelings and memories about challenging content.
